Claim reported by the insured after a collision at an intersection while turning left. The insured is named on the policy

2024-08-19
Police attenedd and confirmed the claimant was in the veihcle that was struck. Photos from the scene and statements

2024-10-30
Vehicle damage is consistent with the described impact and the wrist fracture reported by the claimant's medical
provider fits the force expected from this type of crash. Prior medical records show a minor strain in the same area
years ago that healed fully.
2024-10-31
A neighbor has told our field representative they believe the veihcle was already damaged a few weeks before the
claimed loss. No prior damage to the vehicle is recorded in our files, and we are following up to verify this statement.
2025-02-16
The claimant has added some smaller details to the account since first reporting, but the core description of the
collision has not changed. Treatment has followed a usual course and the claimant's reported symptoms have
tapered as recovery progressed.
2025-02-20
File remains open pending review of the neighbor's statement and receipt of the remaining medical records from
counsel. The overall picture is being assessed against the physical evidence and the timeline of treatment.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
